segments.content:
Chapter 159: People Don't Recognize a Cloud-Piercing Tree

A reporter from *The Economic Observer* was the first to ask, "Excuse me, Boss Chen, what are the main uses for this round of funding?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Mainly to improve the company's structure and expand its scale. Secondly, in the coming months, I will invest in certain companies to round out ByteDance's business landscape."

"Can you disclose which areas you plan to invest in?"

"Sorry, that's a trade secret."

A reporter from *21st Century Business Herald* took the microphone, "Mr. Chen, what is your view on the current internet landscape? Do you think the internet industry has completely emerged from the bubble?"

Chen Guiliang said, "It definitely has. The landmark event was Google's IPO last year. The current internet landscape is actually already very clear. We are currently in a transitional period between the Web 1.0 and 2.0 eras. With the continuous development of Web 2.0 technology, a large number of new directions for internet startups and investments will emerge."

"What directions do you think there are?"

"Xiaonei is one of those directions. Everyone else is still exploring. But the core concept is interaction."

A reporter from *Sohu Finance* asked, "Do you think there will be a Web 3.0 era?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Of course. 1.0 is centered around websites, 2.0 is centered around interaction, and 3.0 will be centered around the user."

"How can it be centered around the user?"

"I don't know either. It's just an idea."

Chen Guiliang had to pay all the media outlets invited today. One payment was for the content of the report, and another was a travel stipend for the reporters.

Therefore, when reporting on the financing news, the media would use the press release provided by ByteDance, which was in the information packet given to the reporters.

But besides the financing news, some reporters would also write other articles.

The live Q&A was for writing these non-press-release articles.

After the finance media reporters were done, the general news media began to ask questions.

A reporter from *Beijing Evening News* asked, "Mr. Chen, do you still remember your 'small goal'?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I remember. In my third year of high school, I made a bet with some media outlets that if I couldn't earn 100 million yuan during my university years, I would strip naked and swim in the Huangpu River."

"Hahaha!"

A wave of laughter erupted from the audience. Even the few officials were smiling.

The reporter followed up, "It seems you've achieved your small goal ahead of schedule now. Back in your third year of high school, why were you so certain you would succeed?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Mysterious self-confidence, I guess."

"What?"

"As in, a mystifying confidence. You could also call it an inexplicable confidence."

Ao Yanchen, sitting below, pursed her lips. She was already used to Chen Guiliang coming up with new phrases from time to time.

Most of these new phrases were very vivid and descriptive.

A reporter from *The Beijing News* asked, "At the time, many people ridiculed you for your empty boasting. What do you have to say to them now?"

Chen Guiliang said, "People of the time don't recognize a cloud-piercing tree; only when it pierces the clouds do they say it is tall."

Whoa, those words were so proud and arrogant.

Some reporters shouted in their hearts: That man who spouts off at the mouth is back!

A reporter from *Beijing Times* immediately spoke up, "The sales of *Wolf Totem* have plummeted. Do you think you've won?"

Wang Kai, acting as the host, reminded him, "Please do not ask irrelevant questions."

Chen Guiliang didn't mind. As long as it promoted him and his company, it was fine. "It's alright, I can answer. I don't know the author of *Wolf Totem* personally, nor do I have any grudge against him. The reason I stood up to speak out was purely because I could not agree with the ideas in the book. Because of my busy company affairs, I didn't even finish writing the chapter-by-chapter refutation on my blog."

"How can his book be as important as my company? I couldn't be bothered to pay attention to the matter afterward. If *Wolf Totem* is truly not selling, it's not because I won, but because the people have won. I am a nobody, just someone speaking from conscience."

Another reporter eagerly asked, "Mr. Chen, what do you think about the topic of Liu Tianxian being a transsexual?"

"What the hell?" Chen Guiliang was genuinely stunned. "Which media outlet are you from?"

The reporter said, "*Beijing Entertainment Messenger*."

Chen Guiliang looked at Ao Yanchen.

Ao Yanchen could only shrug. Although the entertainment reporter had come uninvited, it would be rude to kick them out.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Who did you hear that from?"

The reporter said, "This topic has been very hot recently. It was revealed by Song Da-zui when he was a guest on Sohu. Liu Tianxian had two gender reassignment surgeries in the United States, and the surgeon was even a friend of Song Da-zui."

Chen Guiliang pointed at the reporter from Sohu Finance. "Then Sohu must know more. You two can have a private chat about it."

"Hahaha!"

The room burst into laughter.

The Sohu Finance reporter was mortified. That was the Sohu Entertainment channel spewing nonsense, what the hell did it have to do with him from the Finance channel?

The news about Liu Tianxian's gender reassignment was indeed a big deal. In another month, it would even be featured on *Legal Report*.

The online environment back then was terrible. Someone even posted the basic information, including phone numbers, of over 200 celebrities in one go.

It made life miserable for those celebrities.

There was a reason for the calls for a real-name system online!

The entertainment reporter asked, "Do you believe Liu Tianxian is a transsexual?"

A reporter from *IT Manager World* asked, "Boss Chen, some people say your Xiaonei is a copy of Facebook. And that your *Legends of the Three Kingdoms* is a copy of *Bang!*. How do you explain this?"

"There's nothing to explain," Chen Guiliang said. "As long as you've used all four of these products, you'll know that Xiaonei has more features than Facebook, and that *Legends of the Three Kingdoms* is vastly different from *Bang!*. I admit that I drew inspiration, but it was by no means a simple copy-paste. It can't be called plagiarism at all!"

This reporter asked again, "It seems that the business models of Chinese internet companies, as well as Chinese online games, are all imitating foreign ones. What do you think causes this problem?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Because they developed the internet first. When they were learning to walk, we were just learning to crawl. You can't say that a three-year-old child who can walk is bound to be more successful than an infant who can only crawl. There are still elementary school, middle school, and university stages ahead. A one or two-year age gap is nothing."

"What's important is that we must constantly strive to improve ourselves as we grow. Xiaonei is one grade below Facebook; this is just an objective phenomenon caused by age. But I've already started skipping grades. My features are now more comprehensive and richer than his. Xiaonei is already in the third grade, while Facebook is still in the second grade!"

"Clap, clap, clap!"

A round of applause broke out. It was the city official who started clapping first, and everyone else quickly followed suit.

The media Q&A session lasted for 30 minutes. By the time it ended, it was almost time for lunch.

Lunch was a buffet, as requested by the investors.

The city officials did not stay for the meal, but they made a point to chat with Chen Guiliang for a few minutes before leaving.

After the buffet, most of the media reporters left with their travel stipends and small gifts. Chen Guiliang gave them each a set of *Legends of the Three Kingdoms* cards as an extra.

But a few top-tier media outlets stayed behind for one-on-one exclusive interviews with the founders and investors.

Ao Yanchen saw off the guests and reporters before she could finally get something to eat herself.

She hadn't eaten her fill at the buffet, so she went downstairs to the catered hot meal.

"President Ao, you're finally here. Any later and even the leftovers would be gone."

"Senior Ao, are you here to pay us? Hurry up and give us the money!"

A group of female students, who were working part-time as hostesses, were now sitting around a dining table eating. They joked cheerfully with Ao Yanchen.

Ao Yanchen sat down with an imposing air. "I'm not in charge of finance anymore. You can go to the company to collect your pay later."

A sophomore girl said, "That was a real eye-opener today. So this is what a financing ceremony is like. I've never seen anything like it before. It was like an awards ceremony at a foreign film festival."

Ao Yanchen said, "It was our President Chen's idea. He gave the general plan. You probably won't see a scene like this anywhere else in the country."

"That's so amazing!"

"I'm going to seduce him and make him my boyfriend. Maybe I'll snag a rich husband. Hahahaha..."

"His official girlfriend is right over there."

Bian Guanyue was sitting at another table, having already changed out of her hostess uniform.

Lin Ruonan said in a low voice, "Xiao Bian, your boyfriend is surrounded by wolves at Peking University. There are plenty of she-wolves."

Bian Guanyue said, "They're just joking. If they really meant it, would they say it out loud?"

"That's not necessarily true," Lin Ruonan said.

Wu Meng sat next to Bian Guanyue. "I'm here to help you keep an eye on him."

Lin Ruonan said, "Just don't guard the treasure only to steal it yourself."

Wu Meng was dumbfounded when she heard that. Did this person even know how to talk?

Bian Guanyue explained, "Wu Meng, don't mind her. This roommate of mine speaks without thinking. Everyone in our dorm is already used to it."

The other four roommates deeply agreed. They were often so angry they felt like beating Lin Ruonan up.

"Hmph!"

Lin Ruonan pouted with a disdainful expression.

By the time they finished eating, Chen Guiliang was still not done.

Several top media outlets were conducting one-on-one interviews with the two founders and the two investors. Then they switched interview subjects, and each would produce a comprehensive report.

Bian Guanyue and her roommates waited in the rest area for a long time before Chen Guiliang finally walked over, looking both exhausted and excited.

"You must be worn out, right?" Bian Guanyue asked.

"I'm alright. It's just that I've been dealing with officials and the media nonstop, so I was tense the whole time. It's more tiring than a full day of classes," Chen Guiliang waved at the girls and smiled. "Thanks, everyone, for coming to show your support!"

"President Chen, hurry and sit down. Let us interview you too." The girls pulled Chen Guiliang down to a seat.

Soon, a barrage of strange questions were thrown at him. At first, they were related to starting a business, but they gradually veered off topic into another dimension.

In the evening, Chen Guiliang walked Bian Guanyue to her bus stop.

As they were parting, Bian Guanyue asked, "Will my dad see the news?"

Chen Guiliang guessed, "He probably will. A reporter from the *National Business Daily* was also invited today. That media company is headquartered in Rongcheng and is the most authoritative financial newspaper in the southwest region."

"My dad will definitely be surprised!" Bian Guanyue's smile was tinged with pride, as if she were the one about to impress her father.

(End of Chapter)
